goalTextEn: Can discuss schedules, routines, and availability confidently.
goalTextKr: 일정, 루틴, 가용 시간에 대해 자신 있게 대화할 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can discuss schedules, routines, and availability confidently.
introduce.goalKr: 일정, 루틴, 가용 시간에 대해 자신 있게 대화할 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: Coordinate a team lunch: discuss schedules, check availability, set a time.
introduce.situationKr: 팀 점심을 조율합니다. 일정을 확인하고 가용 시간을 묻고 시간을 정합니다.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we will practice can discuss schedules, routines, and availability confidently.."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
Keep the pace steady. Encourage full sentences.

vocabulary.definition: a plan of times and tasks

pronunciation.instructionKr: 복습: 시간 관련 발음과 강세를 연습합시다. (3챕터)

tutorNotes.text: "Let's learn the key patterns for today."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach vocabulary with short examples.
"Now, let's practice pronunciation."
Correct only 1-2 key issues each round.

understand.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct pattern. Then practice the pattern drills.
understand.instructionKr: 빈칸에 올바른 표현을 넣으고 패턴 드릴을 연습하세요.

examples.en: At 9:00, I check emails. The meeting starts at 10:30.

patternDrills.label: Routine review
patternDrills.template: I usually ___. In the morning, I ___. After lunch, I ___.

examples.en: I usually start at 9. In the morning, I check tasks. After lunch, I join meetings.
examples.kr: 보통 9시에 시작하고, 아침에는 업무를 확인하며, 점심 후에는 회의에 참석합니다.

patternDrills.label: Availability review
patternDrills.template: Are you free on ___? I have ___ at ___. I am available after ___.

examples.en: Are you free on Thursday? I have a meeting at 1. I am available after 2.
examples.kr: 목요일에 시간 되세요? 1시에 회의가 있고 2시 이후는 가능해요.

tutorNotes.text: Do the fill-in-the-blank first.
Run drills with substitutions and faster pace in the second round.
If stuck, give the first word or time as a hint.

steps.title: Step 1 - Repeat After Me
steps.content:
1. The meeting is at 10:30.
2. At 9:00, I check emails.
3. I usually take lunch at 12.
4. Are you free on Thursday?
5. Sorry, I'm busy on Friday.
6. Let's meet from 12 to 1.

tutorNotes.text: Read each line. Student repeats with correct rhythm.
Quickly fix the key pronunciation focus for this lesson.
Keep the student speaking more than you.

steps.title: Step 2 - Personalize It
steps.instructionEn: Complete the lines with your own information.

tutorNotes.text: Have the student fill in first, then read aloud.
Ask 1-2 follow-up questions to extend answers.
Encourage realistic times and tasks.

steps.title: Step 3 - Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice this dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: We need to plan a team lunch this week.
dialogue.kr: 이번 주에 팀 점심을 잡아야 합니다.

dialogue.en: OK. The meeting is at 10:30, so lunchtime is better.
dialogue.kr: 좋아요. 10시 30분에 회의가 있으니 점심이 더 나아요.

dialogue.en: I have an appointment at 1, but I'm available after 2.
Sounds good. Let's meet from 12:15 to 1.

tutorNotes.text: Do it once reading, then once without reading.
Switch roles if time allows.
Focus on clarity and speed.

steps.title: Step 4 - Free Speaking
steps.instructionEn: Speak freely using at least 5 sentences.
steps.content:
Include:
- Mention one fixed meeting time
- Describe your usual lunch time
- Ask about availability
- Offer an alternative time
- Confirm the final plan

tutorNotes.text: "Speak without notes. Try to connect your sentences."
Do not interrupt. Take notes and give feedback after.
Give one grammar correction and one pronunciation correction.

challenge.scenarioEn: Final review: plan a lunch by combining schedule lines, routine statements, and availability questions.
challenge.scenarioKr: 최종 복습: 일정, 루틴, 가용 질문을 함께 사용하여 점심 시간을 잡아보세요.

tutorNotes.text: "Challenge time. Use today's patterns naturally."
Ask follow-up questions to test flexibility.
Success = correct key patterns + clear times + smooth flow.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category and answer the questions.

categories.title: TIME MANAGEMENT
questions: How do you manage your schedule?

categories.title: TEAM COORDINATION
questions: Is it hard to find a common time?
How do you communicate schedule changes?

categories.title: NEXT CHAPTER
questions: When do you need to make requests at work?
What requests do you make often?
Do you feel comfortable asking for help?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, a short discussion."
Discuss for 3-5 minutes.
Prompt reuse of target patterns.
